main_text.l: 19. OSolyma, ante alias Domini natale verendum,
Charus ager Domino: tibi nā mysteria primū
10.[?] Ipsemet exhibuit, tibi leges præbuit æquas,
Et non est reliquos tanto dignatus honore.
3. Lauda fermide[?] Sol, Luna nitens, ignea sydera,
5. Vos laudate Deum: voce etenim condidit omnia:
7. Huc laudate homines, monstra, dracones, freta, (ne:
8. Ignis, nix, glacies, grando, gelu, flammaque, turbi-
9. Mōtes, culmina, cedri steriles, frugiferæ arbores,
10. Bruta, infecta, feræ, quadrupedes, reptilia, atq;
11. Vos Reges, proceres, curia, plebs, cōsiliarij, (aues
12. Pubes mixta viris, virginibus decrepiti senes,
14. Vos laudate, sui[?] ñam populi cornua prouehet.

page.notes: The scan is cut off at the right edge, so line ends in verses 3, 6, 12 and 14 may be incomplete. The verse 2 fragment at the foot is cut off at the page edge. Verse number "10.[?]" at the top is read as 10 but could be 20. "fermide[?]" in verse 3 is uncertain. "edictoq;" in verse 6 is hard to make out. "sui[?]" in verse 14 is doubtful. "(ne:" and "(aues" are printed in the line at the right of verses 7 and 11, and are kept there as printed. The pointing of "Mōtes" in verse 9 and "cōsiliarij" in verse 11 may be an abbreviation mark rather than a macron. Two printed "Lætare" forms are uncertain at the page edge.
